crossRefs.note: Why then didn’t you obey Yahweh’s voice, but took the plunder, and did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight?”
But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.
“ ‘It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that you shall eat neither fat…
You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.
Whoever it is who eats any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’ ”
“ ‘Any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who eats any kind of blood, I…
“ ‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it. You shall not use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.
Only you shall not eat the blood. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.
Only be sure that you don’t eat the blood; for the blood is the life. You shall not eat the life with the meat.
You shall not eat it. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.
Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed…
but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is…
that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from…

translations.web: and the people pounced on the plunder, and took sheep, cattle, and calves, and killed them on the ground; and the people ate them with the blood.
translations.bsb: So they rushed greedily to the plunder, taking sheep, cattle, and calves. They slaughtered them on the ground and ate meat with the blood still in it.
translations.kjv: And the people flew upon the spoil, and took sheep, and oxen, and calves, and slew them on the ground: and the people did eat them with the blood.
translations.asv: and the people flew upon the spoil, and took sheep, and oxen, and calves, and slew them on the ground; and the people did eat them with the blood.
